unresolved: Four related patients from one family; literature cases in Table 1 (Ref 2-5) are not patients of this article and are excluded.
Table 1 values for the four patients are merged into the matching text facts only where they state the same finding (ECD, CAG repeats, MRI, optic atrophy); unmatched table cells are separate facts.
Values printed inside figure or supplement images are pixel content and are kept out of clinical facts.
Discussion cohort-level comparisons (reduced ECD/HEX against published normal values; absence of a CAG-repeat relationship) are not copied to individuals.

Supplementary Figures 1-3 are single-page PDFs reviewed in the supplement sidecars; their caption text adds a left-eye RNFL average for Patient 2 and fundus findings for Patient 3 that the main text does not give.
Caption-layer visual status is not_inspected; the image pixels are described in visual.json.
